# Release Contract Requirements Checklist: CLI, Compatibility, Documentation, and Package Verification

**Purpose**: Formal reviewer gate for CLI streams, state writes, migration guidance, and distributable package evidence
**Created**: 2026-08-02
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: Generated by `$speckit-checklist` as unit tests for the final integration requirements.

## Contract Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Is the successful generation root defined consistently for Node, CLI stdout, and result files? [Completeness, Spec FR-001–FR-004]
- [x] CHK002 Are success, runtime failure, usage failure, report logging, and result-file logging stream rules all specified? [Completeness, Spec FR-002–FR-003 and FR-010]
- [x] CHK003 Are both supported configuration versions and every retained command addressed? [Completeness, Spec FR-007–FR-010]
- [x] CHK004 Are complete-catalog, disposition, removal, usage, diagnostics, and no-op semantics represented? [Completeness, Spec FR-001 and FR-008–FR-011]

## Boundary and Failure Clarity

- [x] CHK005 Is the result-file base root unambiguous rather than merely described as project-relative? [Clarity, Spec FR-004–FR-005; Assumptions]
- [x] CHK006 Are empty, absolute, traversal, NUL, symlink, and junction cases explicitly covered? [Coverage, Spec Edge Cases and FR-005]
- [x] CHK007 Is atomic write-if-changed behavior distinguished from artifact publication and ownership? [Clarity, Spec FR-005–FR-006; Key Entities]
- [x] CHK008 Is command failure behavior explicit when artifact generation succeeds but result-file publication fails? [Recovery, Spec FR-006; Edge Cases]

## Compatibility Consistency

- [x] CHK009 Is direct generation JSON identified as a deliberate breaking change while other safe JSON commands remain compatible? [Consistency, Spec FR-001, FR-009, FR-013; Assumptions]
- [x] CHK010 Are authoritative and retained legacy Node surfaces distinguished without implying removed mutation compatibility? [Clarity, Spec FR-012–FR-014]
- [x] CHK011 Do exit-code and error-document requirements agree across human and JSON modes? [Consistency, Spec FR-003 and FR-010]
- [x] CHK012 Are reporting and target-filter compatibility bounded by the constitution rather than promised unconditionally? [Consistency, Spec FR-007–FR-009]

## Migration Guidance Quality

- [x] CHK013 Are before/after Node and CLI examples required as executable public-surface transitions? [Completeness, Spec FR-014; US3]
- [x] CHK014 Are web HTML, Android, iOS, and React Native caller responsibilities individually covered? [Coverage, Spec US3/AC3–AC4 and FR-014]
- [x] CHK015 Are every removed mutation concept and web policy rename required in the inventory? [Completeness, Spec US3/AC5 and FR-014]
- [x] CHK016 Are root versus individual package documentation responsibilities scoped to avoid contradiction and duplication? [Clarity, Spec FR-015]

## Package Verification Quality

- [x] CHK017 Are packing, tarball-only installation, dependency resolution, public exports, declarations, runtime imports, and CLI execution all required? [Completeness, Spec FR-016–FR-017]
- [x] CHK018 Does installed CLI evidence include human, JSON, result-file, and unchanged-repeat flows? [Coverage, Spec FR-017; US4]
- [x] CHK019 Are packed scans scoped across runtime, declarations, manifests, schema, and current documentation? [Clarity, Spec FR-018]
- [x] CHK020 Is dependency lifecycle-script suppression documented for the disposable consumer fixture? [Safety, Spec Edge Cases; Assumptions]

## Measurability and Completion

- [x] CHK021 Can stdout purity, result equality, boundary rejection, idempotency, migration imports, and tarball consumption each be objectively measured? [Measurability, Spec SC-001–SC-006]
- [x] CHK022 Is the zero-forbidden-capability completion signal separated from historical ADR discussion? [Measurability, Spec SC-007; Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK023 Are full checks, Spec Kit analysis/convergence, warning classification, and final status all required? [Completeness, Spec FR-019–FR-020 and SC-008]
- [x] CHK024 Does the specification exclude commit, push, publication, remote mutation, and restored integration hooks? [Boundary, Spec Assumptions]
